subject: Film & Cinema
title: The Writer vs. The Director
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Writer vs. The Director.

hook.text: In Hollywood, the director is the auteur. The writer is often invisible.

buildup.text: Directors can rewrite scripts on set. Writers are rarely invited to watch filming.

discovery.text: The WGA fought for decades to ensure writers receive credit and residual payments.

twist.text: Writer-directors like Nolan and Gerwig bypass the conflict by doing both jobs.

climax.text: The 2023 writers' strike proved the industry still undervalues its storytellers.

punchline.text: No script, no movie. Hollywood keeps forgetting.

quiz.question: What did the 2023 WGA strike highlight?
options: Directors should write their own scripts
